title: BAYHOST/BTHA: Bavaria’s Annual Scholarship Programme
summary: Annual scholarships funded by Bavaria for graduates from the Czech Republic to pursue postgraduate studies, Master’s programmes, or PhD programmes at Bavarian higher education institutions, or a one-year research stay.

degree_levels.notes: Postgraduate programmes (e.g. Master’s programmes, but not Bachelor’s programmes) or PhD programmes.

subject_areas.notes: Postgraduate programmes or PhD programmes in all subjects are eligible for funding.

institutions.notes: Bavarian state higher education institution, a state-recognised higher education institution run by a religious body, or a college of art or music.

residence.notes: Permanent residence in the Czech Republic at the time of applying for the scholarship.

mandatory.text: Permanent residence in the Czech Republic at the time of applying for the scholarship
Under 30 years of age (for Master’s programmes) or under 35 years of age (for PhD programmes) at the time the scholarship is first awarded
The study or research stay at a Bavarian higher education institution cannot be funded from the applicant’s own resources or from third-party funds
Proficiency in German and/or English appropriate to the study or research project in Bavaria (generally C1 level)
Well above-average academic performance at a higher education institution in the home country
Enrolment at the chosen Bavarian higher education institution for the duration of the scholarship

exceptions.text: Justified exceptions may be made for age limits
For doctoral programmes in Bavaria, in well-justified and clearly documented exceptional cases, the funding may be extended a third time for up to one or two further semesters.

funding.description: The grant is expected to be paid in twelve monthly instalments of 992 EUR each. Grant recipients with at least one child may also apply for a family allowance (160 EUR per month).
funding.duration: Initially awarded for one year and may be extended, upon application, a maximum of twice (to a total of three years).

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline for a scholarship (first-time applications): 1 December 2026

required_documents.text: All documents must be submitted online via the BAYHOST / BTHA StipSys form

steps.text: Submit all documents online via the BAYHOST / BTHA StipSys form.
